items.text: Puka Nacua officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury; Rams optimistic after feeling better Saturday, no setbacks.
items.why: Did not practice Fri but source: feel good if no setbacks; confirmed active.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR1; late GTD resolved positively.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected in depleted LAR WR room (Adams out).

items.text: Breece Hall officially inactive (quad); unlikely all week as not full participant yet after missing three games.
items.why: Sources: bit early, may workout but not full; confirmed inactive.
items.implication: Sit; handcuff/committee lead elevated for another week.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen (or Jets RB depth) full workload vs MIA.

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Week 7 vs Bengals (high ankle sprain); previously questionable. Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday after limited practice; confirmed by multiple sources.
items.implication: Ravens QB streamer needed; impacts BAL skill players volume slightly.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos in snap share 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins only 21% snaps. Roster in 100% leagues.
items.why: Preseason call confirmed by post-return usage dominance.
items.implication: Add/start Coleman; Dobbins downgraded in committee.
items.opportunity: Lead back role expansion for Coleman.

items.text: Seahawks opening Jadarian Price 21-day practice window (eligible W8); JT trade suitors include SEA/DEN/MIN/GB. Unsure Price status for MNF.
items.implication: SEA RB depth boost possible; JT trade value watch.
items.opportunity: Price return could share with Walker/Charbonnet; JT landing spot boost.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would be tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.implication: No downgrade ROS/weekly; continue as RB1.

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/activated and expected to play in season debut for Packers.
items.why: Activated; not on report, LaFleur positive.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 consideration post-layoff; monitor snap share.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT for Eagles (hamstring/ankle).
items.implication: PHI pass game thinner; elevates other targets.
items.opportunity: Dallas Goedert, remaining WRs, or Saquon receiving work up.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY (hamstring) for Eagles MNF.
items.implication: Start if cleared; monitor final inactive.

items.text: Nico Collins led Texans with 24 routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks; Tank Dell only 6 in return (first since 2024); Noel left early turf toe.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell limited role initially.
items.opportunity: Nico target share secure; Dell handcuff/depth.

items.text: Aaron Jones knee injury (suffered Sunday) not significant; source describes as day-to-day.
items.implication: Monitor practice; likely plays Week 8, handcuff ready.

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game w/o Rice); historical note: never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.implication: Ceiling capped historically despite opportunity; volatile WR3/flex.
items.opportunity: Route share spike with Rice out (hamstring).
items.conflict: High volume vs low historical production ceiling.

items.text: Jets WR routes w/ AD Mitchell back: Garrett Wilson 29, Omar Cooper 23 (efficient 12-248-2 on 13 tgts season), Mitchell 18 on 33 dropbacks.
items.implication: Wilson secure WR1; Cooper emerging efficiency.
items.opportunity: Wilson routes high; Cooper sleeper upside.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain on severity; watched post-game.
items.why: Levitan assessment after ETR watch list.
items.implication: Monitor; could open more for Tracy or backups if misses time.
